# Barbara Shaw

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P2](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Aunt Mary](../character/aunt-mary.md) (relative), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Barbara Shaw is a tall and awkward girl. She often appears ungainly, giving the impression of having too many hands and feet.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## Personality

Barbara Shaw is known among the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) scholars for her remarkable clumsiness. Her frequent trips and stumbles, whether over her own feet or those of others, are so habitual that any instance of her walking down the aisle without falling is considered a noteworthy event.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## History

Barbara Shaw was a young girl who came to live with her aunt in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). As a pupil at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, she fell under the instruction of the new schoolteacher, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). During a creative writing assignment, Barbara submitted a humorous composition about a little boy who was so bad his mother couldn't put up with him, so she washed his face, curled his hair, and sent him off to school.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P14](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0014), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P16](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0016), +107 more_
